name: Nagarkot to Changu Narayan
why: A gentle half day down the ridge from Nagarkot through villages and terraces to the oldest temple of the valley, a World Heritage site.
book: Ticket for the Changu Narayan temple. Taxi or bus back to Bhaktapur (30 min).
water: Tea shops in Telkot and Changu village.
dangers: Stretches on a village road with cars and motorbikes.

points.name: Nagarkot
points.note: Start after the sunrise from the view tower.

points.name: Telkot
points.note: A small crossroads village on the ridge.

points.name: Changu Narayan
points.note: A two-roofed Vishnu temple of the 5th century, its struts carved with gods.
